metadata.description: Mods and skills that ship with Catalyst and are installed into Claude Code when Catalyst is installed or updated.

plugins.name: catalyst-guard
plugins.description: Holds destructive shell commands (rm -rf, Remove-Item -Recurse, git reset --hard, force push...) until you confirm them.

plugins.name: catalyst-meter
plugins.description: Context fill, session cost, rate-limit use and tool calls on the status line, with a nudge before the window fills.

plugins.name: catalyst-orchestrator
plugins.description: The orchestrate skill for splitting work across parallel subagents, and a live band of the agents running.
